principles: Keep claim control boundaries explicit and reproducible.
Do not mix runtime implementation status with documentation contract status.
Prefer precise, measurable criteria over narrative claims.
drivers: Terminology drift can still imply production-grade or scientific proof.
Benchmark fairness omissions make control experiments non-comparable.
No milestone axis leads to duplicate or prematurely assumed implementation.

options.name: Doc-hardening completion in this story
pros: Prevents overstatement and reduces future implementation ambiguity

options.name: Delay wording fixes to first runtime story
pros: One story does all contract and code together
cons: Increases chance of overclaim in interim work; harder to test alignment.

rationale: Documenting the contract boundary and benchmark baseline now reduces downstream variance and creates a reliable target for future implementation stories.
